evidence.reason: The current tip still builds each QEMU -drive option by interpolating the resolved run path directly into a comma-delimited option string. QEMU treats commas as option separators and requires embedded commas to be doubled, so a state directory such as `probe,local` yields malformed drive options and QEMU cannot open the overlay/seed. Nothing in the supplied code validates or escapes comma-containing paths. This is a routine correctness defect, not a new requirement or an accepted limitation.
